nodes.claim: The side-two four-dimensional block has interior links of plaquette incidence degree six.
The center-staple map from the remaining links to the six incident staples has GF(2) rank six.
An admissible conditioning gives the selected link density p_t(U)^5 p_t(-U) dU.
The conditional class-angle rate is I_6(theta)=5 theta^2+(pi-theta)^2 with unique minimizer pi/6.
For rho<5pi/6, the supremum over microscopic conditionings of the bad-plaquette probability tends to one as t tends to zero.
A good-collar, multi-link, or contour activity bound charges frustrated conditionings to their containing polymer.
The complete four-dimensional link measure satisfies a volume-uniform weighted connected-activity bound.
The activity and local-action norms remain summable through enough RG steps to enter the rigidity basin.
Continuum pure Yang--Mills exists and OS reconstruction yields the Hamiltonian mass gap.

forbidden_promotions: Failure of worst-case microscopic conditioning does not imply failure of a full-measure contour or polymer expansion.
A center-valued local frustration is not by itself a thermodynamic topological-sector theorem.
A finite-block obstruction is not continuum construction or a mass-gap result.
